extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology record; automated pending-review mechanism placeholders were replaced with bounded primary-source claims.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Lantha-12 and lanrip-12 directly disrupted bacterial membranes and caused cell lysis in microscopy assays at 2 × MIC for 5 min.
direct_assay_types: fluorescence microscopy membrane permeability and cell-lysis assay
mechanism_claims.limitations: Directly supports membrane disruption/cell lysis under assay conditions; does not establish a molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Time-killing assays support bactericidal activity of lantha-12 and lanrip-12 against MRSA and E. coli, with slower E. coli kill than polymyxin B.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Bactericidal kinetics are activity-mode evidence, not a specific molecular mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The LPS/intermembrane-protein discussion is retained as comparative thanatin background and is not promoted to a direct mechanism for the semisynthetic compounds.
